readings.meaning: short note, description, or body text

ambiguity: In a to-do list row, three horizontal lines look exactly like a drag-to-reorder handle or a menu button rather than a task topic icon, and are nearly indistinguishable from other alignment, sort, or list icons.

reasoning: Three left-aligned horizontal bars are standard UI chrome for text alignment, a hamburger menu, or a drag handle rather than a real-world object. In a task list, users will mistake it for an interactive row control, and tasks about writing or notes are much better served by a document, notepad, or pencil icon.
